items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions Wynonie Harris in the context of a recording session, but the INTERVIEWEE only responds 'Right' without confirming any personal interaction or relationship with Harris.

ctx.x: He has the James Brown on there, Wynonie Harris. And like I said, he’s got a lot, I looked down there and I was saying, “Kenny is in the studio every week with somebody else.” I mean, March of ’57 you were just bam, bam, bam. And then some days were double I’m looking at the date and you’re doing two sessions. Like you mentioned the one with Red Garland.
